steps.title: Download Zoom for your Mac
steps.explanation: Click the download button for your Mac chip. This Mac has Apple silicon, so choose Download (Apple Silicon). The installer will save to your Downloads folder.

steps.title: Open the Zoom installer
steps.explanation: Double-click the downloaded Zoom file to start the installer. Follow the on-screen prompts to move Zoom into Applications.

steps.title: Open Zoom
steps.explanation: Open Zoom from Applications or Launchpad to finish setup and sign in.
